summary: Require every active fleet incarnation to advertise declared admission support before publication

replay.detail: The compatibility barrier applies only to new local publication; receipt and replay retain their existing behavior.

schema.detail: No storage schema or claim kind changes. The barrier consumes authenticated features.declared_admission=1 advertisements; daemon feature advertisement is supplied by the companion integration change.

rules.detail: No resource budget is enforced. This is a declaration compatibility barrier, not scheduling or resource admission. Direct claims retain one typed declaration validation before this compatibility barrier.

compatibility.detail: Publication containing any declared-priority, declared-lane or declared-budgets child, including empty budgets and memberless agents, requires signed anchored current membership and latest authenticated support from every active incarnation. Missing, false, conflicted or unanchored evidence and unfenced legacy writers refuse the entire publication before writes. Keep every member on a supporting binary while populated metadata exists. This is an ongoing requirement. The gate checks support only at write time. It does not prevent a member from starting an old binary or joining later. An old member drops agent metadata and fails mission revision validation.

downtime.detail: No data migration. All active daemons must run an upgraded binary that publishes the durable feature advertisement before declared admission metadata can be published.

manual.detail: Upgrade every active member or fence legacy peers before publishing declared admission metadata. Wait until membership and feature advertisements are authenticated.

recovery.detail: Keep upgraded readers while metadata is active. Remove the metadata with upgraded readers before a rollback to older models.
